retrievalProfile.description: A high-glamour studio portrait featuring a subject reclining in shallow water against a vibrant sunset backdrop framed by translucent curtains.
excludeWhen: minimalist or high-key white backgrounds are requested
urban or gritty textures are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure reclining gracefully in a shallow pool of water that creates liquid ripples and reflections. She wears intricate crystal-beaded attire. The background consists of a vibrant orange and purple sunset sky visible through a central opening between two tall, peach-colored pleated curtains or blinds. The lighting is warm and directional, highlighting the skin's texture and the sparkle of the crystals.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between vertical curtain frames
Horizontal body line contrasting with vertical curtain lines
Liquid surface reflecting the warm sky and subject
Sparkling crystal textures against smooth skin and soft clouds
coreInvariants: Shallow water surface with visible ripples
Sunset color palette (orange, peach, soft purple)
High-contrast specular highlights on jewelry and skin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally positioned, reclining horizontally across the lower middle third of the frame, appearing at a medium-full scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the intricate crystal bodice serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical lines of the curtains down to the subject, then travels horizontally along her reclining pose, finally settling on the reflections in the water.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper sky area and the outer edges of the curtains provide balanced negative space that directs focus inward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm peach and orange tones (background and curtains)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep amber and bronze (shadows and water reflections)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool lavender and white (upper sky and crystal highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with a luminous, glowing quality; mid-to-high value range with deep, rich shadows in the water.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio set with a shallow pool of water on the floor. In the background, place a vibrant sunset sky with orange and purple clouds. Frame the sky with two tall, peach-colored pleated curtains or venetian blinds on either side. Ensure the water surface captures the warm sky colors and ripples.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a high-contrast serif font centered in the upper sky area or a delicate script following the curve of the water ripples.

verificationChecks: Water reflections match the sky and subject
Skin tones are warm and luminous
Crystal details have sharp specular highlights

mustRedesign: Avoid flat lighting that kills the sparkle
Ensure the water does not look like a solid floor
postGenerationChecks: Is the subject's reflection visible in the water?
Do the curtains frame the sky symmetrically?
Is the lighting consistent across the subject and background?
Are the crystal highlights sharp and distinct?
Does the color palette feel cohesive and warm?
recipe.reuseFormula: A [Subject] reclining in [Shallow Water] with [Rippled Reflections], framed by [Vertical Peach Curtains] against a [Vibrant Sunset Sky], wearing [Crystal Embellishments], in a [High-Glamour Studio] style.
